title: Coldest Morning, Dead Battery, Grandma's Gift ❄️ | Verdict Picks Toon Ep.6 #Shorts
description:
The coldest morning of the year. Jo's car just clicks, Grandma June is waiting, and nobody will stop for a jump.
Then Jo remembers what's in the gift box on the back seat.

Verdict Picks Toon, Episode 6. Our full NOCO Boost Plus GB40 review, with the price to wait for and how to use it:
https://acts39.blogspot.com/2026/10/noco-gb40-jump-starter-review-2026.html

Facts in this Short: The GB40's list price is $99.95 at NOCO's store (November 2026); our guide calls about $75 to $80 a good price. A paid roadside jump without a membership costs about $50 to $120 per call, per third-party estimates we could not confirm at the source; they vary by region (our NOCO GB40 vs GB50 vs GOOLOO guide, October 30, 2026). Clamp order and the recharge habit follow NOCO's GB40 instructions as summarised in our guide: red to positive, black to negative or bare metal, press Power; top it up every few months.

Characters and scenes are fictional. Art and voices generated with Google Gemini (AI); story, lettering and facts by Verdict Picks. Not sponsored by any brand. Our guides contain affiliate links: as an Amazon Associate we earn from qualifying purchases.
